items.meaning: SIP works in concert with protocols that carry real-time multimedia session data such as voice, video, or text messages.
Gateway Control Protocol used for controlling gateways to the PSTN.
Session Description Protocol used for describing multimedia sessions.
SIP should be used in conjunction with other protocols to provide complete services to users.
Basic functionality and operation of SIP does not depend on MEGACO, SDP, or other protocols.
SIP does not provide services; it provides primitives that can be used to implement different services.
SIP can locate a user and deliver an opaque object to the user's current location.
A primitive can deliver a session description written in SDP so endpoints can agree on session parameters.
A single primitive is typically used to provide several different services.
Key word is to be interpreted as described in BCP 14/RFC 2119 and indicates requirement levels for compliant SIP implementations.
Method name in the first line of the text-encoded message in the example.
A type of SIP server known as a proxy server.
Receives SIP requests and forwards them on behalf of the requestor.
The proxy server receives the INVITE request and sends a 100 (Trying) response back to Alice's softphone.
Response indicates that the INVITE has been received and the proxy is working to route it to the destination.
Responses in SIP use a three-digit code followed by a descriptive phrase.
Response contains the same To, From, Call-ID, CSeq, and Via branch parameter as the INVITE, allowing correlation.
DNS lookup can be used to find the SIP server that serves the biloxi.com domain.
Before forwarding the request, the atlanta.com proxy server adds an additional Via header field value containing its own address.
The INVITE already contains Alice's address in the first Via.
The biloxi.com proxy server receives the INVITE and responds with a 100 (Trying) response back to the atlanta.com proxy server to indicate receipt and processing.
A database containing the current IP address of Bob.
The biloxi.com proxy server adds another Via header field value with its own address to the INVITE and proxies it to Bob's SIP phone.
Each proxy uses the Via header field to determine where to send the response and removes its own address from the top.
DNS and location service lookups were required to route the initial INVITE in this example.
Bob's SIP phone sends a 200 (OK) response to indicate that the call has been answered.
The 200 (OK) contains a message body with the SDP media description of the type of session Bob is willing to establish with Alice.
The two-phase exchange of SDP messages is based on a simple offer/answer model of SDP exchange.
The complete list of SIP response codes is in Section 21.
If Bob's SIP phone returned a 486 (Busy Here) response, the biloxi.com proxy server could proxy the INVITE to Bob's voicemail server.
A proxy server can send an INVITE to a number of locations at the same time, and this type of parallel search is known as forking.
Alice's softphone sends an acknowledgement message, ACK, to Bob's SIP phone to confirm the reception of the final response 200 (OK).
The endpoints have learned each other's address from the Contact header fields through the INVITE/200 (OK) exchange.
The INVITE/200/ACK three-way handshake is used to establish SIP sessions.
Full details on session setup are in Section 13.
A re-INVITE references the existing dialog so the other party knows it modifies an existing session rather than establishing a new session.
items.constraint: references the existing dialog

items.meaning: The other party sends a 200 (OK) to accept the change.
items.constraint: to accept the change

items.meaning: The requestor responds to the 200 (OK) with an ACK.
items.constraint: responds to the 200 (OK) with an ACK

items.meaning: If the other party does not accept the change, it sends an error response such as 488 (Not Acceptable Here), which also receives an ACK.
items.constraint: error response such as 488 (Not Acceptable Here) also receives an ACK

items.meaning: Failure of a re-INVITE does not cause the existing call to fail; the session continues using previously negotiated characteristics.
items.constraint: does not cause the existing call to fail

items.meaning: Proxies in the SIP signaling path may see all messaging between endpoints for the duration of the session.
items.constraint: may see all messaging between endpoints for the duration of the session

items.meaning: A proxy adds to the INVITE a required routing header field known as Record-Route containing a URI resolving to the hostname or IP address of the proxy.
items.constraint: required routing header field known as Record-Route

items.meaning: The Record-Route header field is passed back in the 200 (OK).
items.constraint: passed back in the 200 (OK)

items.meaning: Due to the Record-Route header field being passed back in the 200 (OK), the information is received by Bob's SIP phone and Alice's softphone and stored for the duration of the dialog.
items.constraint: stored for the duration of the dialog

items.meaning: The biloxi.com proxy server would receive and proxy the ACK, BYE, and 200 (OK) to the BYE.
items.constraint: proxy the ACK, BYE, and 200 (OK) to the BYE

items.meaning: Each proxy can independently decide to receive subsequent messages, and those messages pass through all proxies that elect to receive them.
items.constraint: each proxy can independently decide to receive subsequent messages

items.meaning: SIP is structured as a layered protocol.
items.constraint: structured as a layered protocol

items.meaning: The layered description does not dictate an implementation in any way.
items.constraint: does not dictate an implementation in any way

items.meaning: When an element contains a layer, it is compliant to the set of rules defined by that layer.
items.constraint: compliant to the set of rules defined by that layer

items.meaning: The layer above the transaction layer is called the transaction user (TU).
items.constraint: layer above the transaction layer

items.meaning: Each SIP entity except the stateless proxy is a transaction user.
items.constraint: except the stateless proxy

items.meaning: When a TU wishes to send a request, it creates a client transaction instance and passes it the request along with the destination IP address, port, and transport.
items.constraint: passes the request along with destination IP address, port, and transport

items.meaning: When a client cancels a transaction, it requests that the server stop further processing, revert to the prior state, and generate a specific error response.
items.constraint: stop further processing, revert to the state before the transaction was initiated, and generate a specific error response

items.meaning: A CANCEL request constitutes its own transaction but references the transaction to be cancelled.
items.constraint: constitutes its own transaction, but references the transaction to be cancelled

items.meaning: SIP elements contain a core that distinguishes them from each other.
items.constraint: contain a core that distinguishes them from each other

items.meaning: For a UAC, common rules govern the construction of a request.
items.constraint: rules govern the construction of a request

items.meaning: For a UAS, these rules govern the processing of a request and generating a response.
items.constraint: rules govern the processing of a request and generating a response

items.meaning: A UAS that handles a REGISTER is given the special name registrar.
items.constraint: UAS that handles a REGISTER is given the special name registrar

items.meaning: Section 11 describes UAC and UAS core behavior for the OPTIONS method, used for determining the capabilities of a UA.
items.constraint: used for determining the capabilities of a UA

items.meaning: dialog 是两个用户代理之间点对点的 SIP 关系，并会持续一段时间
INVITE 方法是本规范中定义的唯一用于建立 dialog 的方式
items.constraint: INVITE 方法是本规范定义的唯一建立 dialog 的方式

items.meaning: B2BUA 是一个逻辑实体：它接收请求并以 UAS 身份处理这些请求，同时以 UAC 身份生成请求
B2BUA 必须参与它已建立的 dialog 上发送的所有请求
items.constraint: B2BUA 必须参与它已建立的 dialog 上发送的所有请求
items.object: all requests sent on the dialogs it has established

items.meaning: 如果代理从发起 INVITE 到终止 BYE 请求期间保留 dialog 状态，那么它就是 call stateful 代理
client 是任何发送 SIP 请求并接收 SIP 响应的网络元素
Core 指某一特定类型 SIP 实体所特有的功能
一个到达代理、被转发、随后又回到同一代理的请求，其 Request-URI 与首次到达时相同且影响代理操作的其它头字段未变。
环回请求属于错误（errors），其检测与处理流程由协议描述。
items.constraint: Looped requests are errors

items.meaning: 代理若遵循本规范中处理 Route 头字段的流程，则称为 loose routing。
从客户端接收请求的代理，即使它可能不是由 Request-URI 解析出的服务器。
作为服务器和客户端双重角色、代表其他客户端发起请求的中间实体。
主要承担路由角色并可在转发前解释与改写请求消息特定部分的中介实体。
客户端针对 3xx 响应，向该响应 Contact 头字段中的一个或多个 URI 生成新请求的行为。
一组有序的 SIP 或 SIPS URI，用来表示在发送某个特定请求时必须经过的代理列表，既可以通过 Record-Route 之类的头域获知，也可以配置得到。
items.constraint: route set 中的代理列表在发送特定请求时必须被逐一经过；route set 可以通过 Record-Route 这类头域获知，也可以通过配置获得。

items.meaning: 借用 SDP 规范定义的多媒体会话，由多媒体发送方与接收方以及它们之间的数据流组成；如果使用 SDP，则由 origin 字段中的用户名、会话 id、网络类型、地址类型和地址元素拼接定义。
如果请求是 INVITE 且最终响应是非 2xx，那么该事务还包含一个针对该响应的 ACK；对 INVITE 请求的 2xx 响应所对应的 ACK 则是一个独立的事务。
items.constraint: 如果请求是 INVITE，且最终响应是非 2xx，事务还包含一个对该响应的 ACK；对 INVITE 请求的 2xx 响应所对应的 ACK 属于独立事务。

items.meaning: 指一个 SIP 请求被路由到某代理后又被转发出去，并再次到达该代理，但这次它与原来不同，因此会导致不同的处理决定；这种情形不是错误，有别于 loop。
items.constraint: spiral 不是错误条件，与 loop 不同；它被视为有效情形。

items.meaning: 一种逻辑实体，它在处理请求时不维护本规范所定义的客户端或服务器事务状态机，而是把收到的每个请求向下游转发，把收到的每个响应向上游转发。
items.constraint: 它不维护本规范定义的客户端或服务器事务状态机；它把收到的请求向下游转发，把收到的响应向上游转发。

items.meaning: 代理若遵循 RFC 2543 及本 RFC 早期草案版本的 Route 处理规则，则称为 strict routing；该规则会导致代理在存在 Route 头域时破坏 Request-URI 内容。
items.constraint: 本规范不使用 strict routing 行为，而采用 loose routing 行为。

items.meaning: 执行 strict routing 的代理也称为 strict routers。
一个逻辑实体，它创建新请求并利用客户端事务状态机发送该请求，该角色仅在对应事务存续期间保持。
发起请求的软件在对应事务存续期间担任 UAC；若之后收到请求，则在处理该事务时承担 user agent server 角色。
UAC 所需的、位于事务层与传输层之上的处理功能集合。
一个逻辑实体，它对 SIP 请求生成响应（接受、拒绝或重定向该请求），该角色仅在对应事务存续期间保持。
响应请求的软件在对应事务存续期间担任 UAS；若之后生成请求，则在处理该事务时承担 user agent client 角色。
UAS 所需的、位于事务层与传输层之上的处理功能集合。
UAC and UAS roles, as well as proxy and redirect server roles, are defined on a transaction-by-transaction basis.
A user agent initiating a call acts as a UAC when sending the initial INVITE request.
The user agent acts as a UAS when receiving a BYE request from the callee.
The same software can act as a proxy server for one request and as a redirect server for the next request.
Proxy, location, and registrar servers defined above are logical entities.
Implementations MAY combine proxy, location, and registrar servers into a single application.
items.constraint: MAY combine them into a single application
items.object: them into a single application

items.meaning: Request (section 7.1) and Response (section 7.2) messages use the basic format of RFC 2822, even though the syntax differs in character set and syntax specifics.
SIP allows header fields that would not be valid RFC 2822 header fields.
Both types of messages consist of a start-line, one or more header fields, an empty line indicating the end of the header fields, and an optional message-body.
The start-line, each message-header line, and the empty line MUST be terminated by a carriage-return line-feed sequence (CRLF).
items.constraint: MUST be terminated by a carriage-return line-feed sequence (CRLF)
items.object: carriage-return line-feed sequence (CRLF)

items.meaning: The empty line MUST be present even if the message-body is not.
items.constraint: MUST be present even if the message-body is not
items.object: empty line
items.condition: even if the message-body is not

items.meaning: Much of SIP's message and header field syntax is identical to HTTP/1.1, except for the above difference in character sets.
[HX.Y] is used to refer to Section X.Y of the current HTTP/1.1 specification (RFC 2616).
Request-Line 以 CRLF 结尾，且除行尾 CRLF 序列外不允许出现 CR 或 LF。
items.constraint: The Request-Line ends with CRLF. No CR or LF are allowed except in the end-of-line CRLF sequence.

items.meaning: 任何元素中都不允许出现线性空白 (LWS)。
items.constraint: No linear whitespace (LWS) is allowed in any of the elements.

items.meaning: Method 字段：本规范定义六个方法——REGISTER、INVITE、ACK、CANCEL、BYE、OPTIONS。
用于注册联系信息 (contact information) 的方法。
用于建立会话 (setting up sessions) 的方法。
用于建立会话 (setting up sessions) 的方法。
用于建立会话 (setting up sessions) 的方法。
用于终止会话 (terminating sessions) 的方法。
用于向服务器查询其能力 (querying servers about their capabilities) 的方法。
记录在标准轨道 RFC 中的 SIP 扩展可以定义额外的方法。
items.object: additional methods
items.condition: documented in standards track RFCs

items.meaning: Request-URI 是 Section 19.1 所述 SIP 或 SIPS URI 或通用 URI，指示该请求所指向的用户或服务。
Request-URI 不得包含未转义的空格或控制字符。
items.constraint: The Request-URI MUST NOT contain unescaped spaces or control characters.
items.object: unescaped spaces or control characters

items.meaning: Request-URI 不得被 "<>" 括起来。
items.constraint: The Request-URI MUST NOT be enclosed in "<>".

items.meaning: SIP 元素可以支持 "sip" 和 "sips" 以外 scheme 的 Request-URI（例如 RFC 2806 的 "tel" URI scheme）。
items.object: Request-URIs with schemes other than "sip" and "sips"

items.meaning: SIP 元素可以用其可用的任何机制转换非 SIP URI，得到 SIP URI、SIPS URI 或其他 scheme。
items.object: non-SIP URIs using any mechanism at their disposal

items.meaning: 请求和响应消息都包含所用的 SIP 版本，并在版本排序、合规要求与版本号升级方面遵循 [H3.1]。
为使实现符合本规范，发送 SIP 消息的应用必须包含值为 "SIP/2.0" 的 SIP-Version。
items.constraint: applications sending SIP messages MUST include a SIP-Version of "SIP/2.0".
items.object: a SIP-Version of "SIP/2.0"
items.condition: To be compliant with this specification

items.meaning: SIP-Version 字符串是大小写不敏感的。
items.constraint: The SIP-Version string is case-insensitive.

items.meaning: 实现必须发送大写的 SIP-Version。
items.constraint: implementations MUST send upper-case.
items.object: upper-case

items.meaning: SIP treats the version number as a literal string.
CR is not allowed except in the final CRLF sequence.
items.constraint: No CR or LF is allowed except in the final CRLF sequence.
items.object: CR or LF
items.keyword_raw: No CR or LF is allowed
items.exception: except in the final CRLF sequence

items.meaning: Status-Code is a 3-digit integer result code indicating the outcome of an attempt to understand and satisfy a request.
Reason-Phrase is intended to give a short textual description of the Status-Code.
Status-Code is intended for use by automata.
Reason-Phrase is intended for the human user.
A client is not required to examine or display the Reason-Phrase.
Implementations may choose other text for the reason phrase.
items.constraint: implementations MAY choose other text
items.object: other text

items.meaning: Accept-Language is a header field of the request that indicates a language.
4xx is Client Error, meaning the request contains bad syntax or cannot be fulfilled at this server.
5xx status class denotes Server Error: the server failed to fulfill an apparently valid request.
6xx status class denotes Global Failure: the request cannot be fulfilled at any server.
Header fields of the same name can be combined into a comma-separated list.
The Contact header field allows a comma-separated list unless the header field value is "*".
The formal grammar for a message-header specified in Section 25 allows an arbitrary amount of whitespace on either side of the colon.
Implementations should avoid spaces between the field name and the colon.
items.constraint: Implementations should avoid spaces between the field name and the colon.
items.object: spaces between the field name and the colon

items.meaning: Implementations should use a single space (SP) between the colon and the field-value.
items.constraint: Implementations should use a single space (SP) between the colon and the field-value.
items.object: a single space (SP) between the colon and the field-value

items.meaning: The relative order of header fields with different field names is not significant.
Header fields needed for proxy processing are RECOMMENDED to appear towards the top of the message to facilitate rapid parsing.
items.constraint: Header fields needed for proxy processing are RECOMMENDED to appear towards the top of the message to facilitate rapid parsing.
items.object: towards the top of the message to facilitate rapid parsing
items.condition: header fields which are needed for proxy processing (Via, Route, Record-Route, Proxy-Require, Max-Forwards, and Proxy-Authorization, for example)

items.meaning: The relative order of header field rows with the same field name is important.
Multiple header field rows with the same field-name MAY be present in a message if and only if the entire field-value for that header field is defined as a comma-separated list.
items.constraint: Multiple header field rows with the same field-name MAY be present in a message if and only if the entire field-value for that header field is defined as a comma-separated list.
items.object: in a message
items.condition: if and only if the entire field-value for that header field is defined as a comma-separated list
items.exception: WWW-Authenticate, Authorization, Proxy-Authenticate, and Proxy-Authorization header fields

items.meaning: It MUST be possible to combine the multiple header field rows into one "field-name: field-value" pair, without changing the semantics of the message, by appending each subsequent field-value to the first, each separated by a comma.
items.constraint: It MUST be possible to combine the multiple header field rows into one "field-name: field-value" pair, without changing the semantics of the message, by appending each subsequent field-value to the first, each separated by a comma.
items.object: the multiple header field rows into one "field-name: field-value" pair by appending each subsequent field-value to the first, each separated by a comma
items.condition: without changing the semantics of the message
items.exception: WWW-Authenticate, Authorization, Proxy-Authenticate, and Proxy-Authorization header fields

items.meaning: 带有这些名称的字段行可以出现在消息中，但因为其语法不遵循第 7.3 节的一般形式，所以不得合并为单个头字段行。
items.constraint: MAY be present in a message
items.object: field rows with these names in a message

items.meaning: 这些字段行不得被合并进单个头字段行。
items.constraint: MUST NOT be combined into a single header field row
items.object: a single header field row
items.condition: since their grammar does not follow the general form listed in Section 7.3

items.meaning: 实现必须能够处理同名头字段行的多种组合形式（每行单值或逗号分隔值）。
items.constraint: MUST be able to process multiple header field rows with the same name in any combination of the single-value-per-line or comma-separated value forms
items.object: multiple header field rows with the same name in any combination of the single-value-per-line or comma-separated value forms

items.meaning: 在头字段值上附加任意数量参数对时，任何给定参数名不得出现多于一次。
items.constraint: MUST NOT appear more than once
items.object: more than once
items.condition: Even though an arbitrary number of parameter pairs may be attached to a header field value

items.meaning: 比较头字段时，字段名总是大小写不敏感的。
除非特定头字段的定义中另有说明，否则字段值是大小写不敏感的。
除非特定头字段的定义中另有说明，否则参数名是大小写不敏感的。
Token 总是大小写不敏感的。
除非另有规定，以带引号字符串形式表达的值是大小写敏感的。
示例中的头字段行，取值为 session;handling=optional。
示例中给出的 Content-Disposition 头字段取值，带 Session 和 HANDLING=OPTIONAL 参数。
只在请求中有意义的头字段；若出现在不匹配其类别的消息（如响应）中则必须被忽略。
items.constraint: 头字段出现在不匹配其类别的消息中时 MUST 被忽略
items.object: header field appearing in a message not matching its category
items.condition: If a header field appears in a message not matching its category (such as a request header field in a response)

items.meaning: 头字段名的缩写形式，定义于第 20 节，可在不改变消息语义的前提下替换较长的头字段名形式。
items.constraint: 紧凑形式 MAY 在任意时刻替换较长的头字段名形式
items.object: the longer form of a header field name
items.condition: at any time without changing the semantics of the message

items.meaning: 同一消息内头字段名可以同时出现长形式和短形式。
items.constraint: 头字段名 MAY 在同一消息内同时以长形式和短形式出现
items.action: appear in both long and short forms
items.object: field name
items.condition: within the same message

items.meaning: 实现必须接受每个头字段名的长形式和短形式。
items.constraint: 实现 MUST 接受每个头字段名的长形式和短形式
items.object: both the long and short forms of each header name

items.meaning: 请求（含扩展中定义的新请求）可以携带消息体，消息体的解释取决于请求方法。
items.constraint: 请求 MAY 包含消息体，除非另有说明
items.object: message bodies

items.meaning: 对于响应消息，请求方法与响应状态码共同决定消息体的类型和解释方式。
所有响应都可以包含消息体。
items.constraint: responses MAY include a body
items.object: a body

items.meaning: 消息体的 Internet 媒体类型必须由 Content-Type 头字段给出。
items.constraint: The Internet media type of the message body MUST be given by the Content-Type header field
items.object: The Internet media type of the message body

items.meaning: 在消息体未经过编码的情况下，必须省略 Content-Encoding 头字段。
items.constraint: otherwise, Content-Encoding MUST be omitted
items.object: Content-Encoding header field
items.condition: otherwise

items.meaning: 在适用时，消息体的字符集作为 Content-Type 头字段值的一部分来指示。
RFC 2046 中定义的 multipart MIME 类型可以在消息体中使用。
items.constraint: The "multipart" MIME type defined in RFC 2046 [11] MAY be used within the body of the message
items.object: The "multipart" MIME type defined in RFC 2046 [11] within the body of the message

items.meaning: 如果远端实现通过不含 multipart 的 Accept 头字段如此要求，发送包含 multipart 消息体的请求的实现必须发送非 multipart 的会话描述。
items.constraint: Implementations that send requests containing multipart message bodies MUST send a session description as a non-multipart message body if the remote implementation requests this through an Accept header field that does not contain multipart
items.object: a session description as a non-multipart message body
items.condition: if the remote implementation requests this through an Accept header field that does not contain multipart

items.meaning: SIP 消息可以包含二进制消息体或消息体部分。
items.constraint: SIP messages MAY contain binary bodies or body parts
items.object: binary bodies or body parts

items.meaning: 当发送方未提供显式 charset 参数时，"text" 类型的媒体子类型默认字符集值为 "UTF-8"。
HTTP/1.1 的 chunked 传输编码不得用于 SIP。
items.constraint: The "chunked" transfer encoding of HTTP/1.1 MUST NOT be used for SIP
items.object: The "chunked" transfer encoding of HTTP/1.1 for SIP

items.meaning: SIP 实现可以使用 UDP 或其他不可靠的数据报协议来承载消息
在使用不可靠数据报协议时，每个数据报承载一个请求或一个响应
实现处理流式传输上的 SIP 消息时必须忽略出现在 start-line 之前的任何 CRLF
items.constraint: stream-oriented transports 上处理 SIP 消息时忽略 start-line 之前的 CRLF
items.object: any CRLF appearing before the start-line
items.condition: Implementations processing SIP messages over stream-oriented transports

items.meaning: Content-Length 头域值用于在流中定位每条 SIP 消息的结束
当 UAC 发送请求时，请求经过若干代理服务器转发给 UAS
当 UAS 生成响应时，响应被朝 UAC 方向转发
该节讨论 UAC 和 UAS 在处理对话之外的请求时与具体方法无关的规则
A valid SIP request formulated by a UAC must at minimum contain the header fields To, From, CSeq, Call-ID, Max-Forwards, and Via.
items.constraint: MUST contain the following header fields: To, From, CSeq, Call-ID, Max-Forwards, and Via
items.object: the following header fields: To, From, CSeq, Call-ID, Max-Forwards, and Via
items.condition: formulated by a UAC

items.meaning: The initial Request-URI of the message should be set to the URI value in the To field, with REGISTER as a notable exception.
items.constraint: SHOULD be set to the value of the URI in the To field
items.object: to the value of the URI in the To field
items.exception: One notable exception is the REGISTER method

items.meaning: The presence of a pre-existing route set can affect the Request-URI of the message.

When a pre-existing route set is present, the Section 12.2.1.1 procedures for populating the Request-URI and Route header field must be followed using the desired Request-URI as the remote target URI.
items.constraint: MUST be followed
items.object: the procedures for populating the Request-URI and Route header field detailed in Section 12.2.1.1
items.condition: When a pre-existing route set is present

items.meaning: The To header field specifies the desired logical recipient of the request or the address-of-record of the target user or resource.
The To header field may contain a SIP or SIPS URI.
items.constraint: MAY contain a SIP or SIPS URI
items.object: a SIP or SIPS URI

items.meaning: All SIP implementations must support the SIP URI scheme.
items.constraint: MUST support the SIP URI scheme
items.object: the SIP URI scheme

items.meaning: Any implementation that supports TLS must support the SIPS URI scheme.
items.constraint: MUST support the SIPS URI scheme
items.object: the SIPS URI scheme
items.condition: that supports TLS

items.meaning: The To header field allows for a display name.
UAC 可以通过多种方式获知如何为特定请求填充 To 头域。
对话之外的请求不得包含 To 标签，该标签用于标识对话的对端。
items.constraint: A request outside of a dialog MUST NOT contain a To tag
items.object: To tag
items.condition: outside of a dialog

items.meaning: 关于 To 头域的更多信息参见 Section 20.39。
From 头域指示请求发起方的逻辑身份，含 URI 与可选显示名。
From 头域允许携带显示名，若客户端身份需隐藏则 UAC 应使用显示名 "Anonymous" 与语法正确但无实际含义的 URI。
items.constraint: A UAC SHOULD use the display name "Anonymous" if the identity of the client is to remain hidden
items.object: display name "Anonymous"
items.condition: if the identity of the client is to remain hidden

items.meaning: 由某个 UA 生成的请求中，From 头字段的值通常由用户或用户本地域的管理员预先配置。
From 字段必须包含一个由 UAC 选择的新 tag 参数。
items.constraint: The From field MUST contain a new "tag" parameter, chosen by the UAC.
items.object: a new "tag" parameter, chosen by the UAC

items.meaning: 关于 From 头字段的更多信息参见 Section 20.20。
Call-ID 头字段作为唯一标识符，用于把一系列消息归为一组。
在对话中，由任一 UA 发送的所有请求和响应里，Call-ID 必须相同。
items.constraint: It MUST be the same for all requests and responses sent by either UA in a dialog.
items.object: for all requests and responses sent by either UA in a dialog

items.meaning: UA 的每次注册中，Call-ID 应该相同。
items.constraint: It SHOULD be the same in each registration from a UA.
items.object: in each registration from a UA

items.meaning: 对于 UAC 在任何对话之外创建的新请求，UAC 必须把 Call-ID 选作在空间和时间上全局唯一的标识符。
items.constraint: In a new request created by a UAC outside of any dialog, the Call-ID header field MUST be selected by the UAC as a globally unique identifier over space and time unless overridden by method-specific behavior.
items.action: be selected by the UAC as
items.object: a globally unique identifier over space and time
items.condition: In a new request created by a UAC outside of any dialog

items.meaning: 所有 SIP UA 都必须有办法保证其产生的 Call-ID 头字段不会被任何其他 UA 无意中生成。
items.constraint: All SIP UAs must have a means to guarantee that the Call-ID header fields they produce will not be inadvertently generated by any other UA.
items.object: that the Call-ID header fields they produce will not be inadvertently generated by any other UA

items.meaning: 对失败响应而重试的请求不被视为新请求，因此不需要新的 Call-ID 头字段
items.constraint: these retried requests are not considered new requests, and therefore do not need new Call-ID header fields

items.meaning: 生成 Call-ID 时推荐使用密码学随机标识符
items.constraint: Use of cryptographically random identifiers (RFC 1750 [12]) in the generation of Call-IDs is RECOMMENDED
items.object: cryptographically random identifiers in the generation of Call-IDs

items.meaning: 实现可以使用 "localid@host" 形式
items.constraint: Implementations MAY use the form "localid@host"
items.object: the form "localid@host"

items.meaning: Call-ID 区分大小写，并按字节逐一比较
items.constraint: Call-IDs are case-sensitive and are simply compared byte-by-byte

items.meaning: 请求的 Call-ID 头字段值的选择不需要配置或人机界面
items.constraint: No provisioning or human interface is required for the selection of the Call-ID header field value for a request

items.meaning: 关于 Call-ID 头字段的更多信息参见 Section 20.8
CSeq 头字段用于标识和排序事务
items.constraint: The CSeq header field serves as a way to identify and order transactions.  It consists of a sequence number and a method.

items.meaning: CSeq 中的方法必须与请求的方法一致
items.constraint: The method MUST match that of the request
items.object: that of the request

items.meaning: 序号值必须可表示为 32 位无符号整数
items.constraint: The sequence number value MUST be expressible as a 32-bit unsigned integer
items.object: a 32-bit unsigned integer

items.meaning: 序号值必须小于 2**31
items.constraint: MUST be less than 2**31

key_manifest.note: ★ 「缓存命中时产物可复现」可保证；★ 「重新调用同一模型能否逐字节相同」**不一定成立**
